Card Q&A.q: Can I change the attack target of a Digimon that isn't affected by effects with an effect that "changes the attack target"?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can. If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.
